hooks.text: 海盗用异常伸长的双臂抓取物体，甚至能拆门、搬家具或破坏岛屿搜刮财宝
hooks.excerpt: You are quite an unusual sailor! I bet you can grab just about anything with those pairs of hands. Dismantle doors, grab furniture, or destroy the island for all I care!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 最多四名船员必须协作、沟通并在怪物环伺的岛上为船长完成搜刮
hooks.excerpt: You and up to three of your closest mates will work together, communicate, and survive as you try to make your ol’ captain rich and happy!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 深入神秘岛屿会提高冒险收益，但只要至少一名船员活着把黄金带回船上即可
hooks.excerpt: Feel the adventurous drive push you deeper into the mysterious island, but make sure that at least one of you lives to carry out the gold.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 伸缩手臂寻宝与朋友合作时会形成令人享受的灾难场面。

excerpts.excerpt: Stretchy-arm treasure hunting turns every expedition into a disaster in the best way, especially with friends.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 海盗恐怖、寻宝与搞怪结合适合合作玩家。

excerpts.excerpt: Great for co-op fans who enjoy horror, loot, and constant goofing around.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。
